nodes.label: Announcement Bar
nodes.rationale: Thin top strip 'NEW ARRIVALS - SHOP NOW' to push new drops.

nodes.label: Dark Theme with Red Accent Design
nodes.norm_label: dark theme with red accent design
nodes.rationale: Near-black backgrounds, white heavy extended display font for headings, red used for prices, badges, CTAs and icons to drive attention to commerce actions.

nodes.label: Site Footer
nodes.rationale: Logo + tagline, and link columns Shop (New Arrivals, Men, Women, Kids), Support (FAQ, Returns & Exchanges, Size Guide, Track Order), Company (Our Story, Quality & Craftsmanship, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions).

nodes.label: Hero Product Carousel
nodes.rationale: Featured product slider with product image tagged NEW ARRIVAL / PREMIUM QUALITY, brand + '2026 Collection', large title, price, description, prev/next arrows with progress line, and giant outlined repeating brand-name watermark text ('Nike') behind it for depth.

nodes.label: Navigation Header
nodes.rationale: Logo left, centered links New In / Apparel / Best Sellers, right-side search, cart and user avatar icons.

nodes.label: New Arrivals Product Grid
nodes.rationale: 4-column product card grid with NEW badges, name and INR price: Oversized Trackpants 799, Cold Shoulder Ruffled Top 699, Tie Die Night Suit 899, Verve Studio Jumpsuit 899; Show More and Shop All Products buttons. Subtitle copy ('objects for the workspace, home, and travel') looks like leftover template text (AMBIGUOUS).

nodes.label: Newsletter Signup CTA
nodes.rationale: 'Ready to upgrade your wardrobe?' email capture with red SUBSCRIBE button, offering 20% off first purchase and early access to drops; privacy policy note.

nodes.label: Oversized Trackpants (Nike, Rs 799)
nodes.rationale: Featured hero product and first New Arrivals item; grey trackpants with black side stripe, priced in INR.

nodes.label: Shop by Category Section
nodes.rationale: Three image tiles (Men's Collection, Women's Collection raised in center, Accessories) each with SHOP NOW link, plus 'View all categories' link; staggered center tile adds visual rhythm.

nodes.label: SIXN Brand (logo)
nodes.rationale: Logo 'SIXN' with red stylized X/IX in the middle; footer tagline 'Designing the future of fashion with sustainability and style in mind'; copyright '2026 SIXN Ecommerce'.

nodes.label: Value Proposition Cards
nodes.rationale: Three trust badges: Free Shipping (orders over $150), Easy Returns (30-day money back), Secure Payment (100% secure checkout). Currency mismatch: $150 here vs INR prices elsewhere (AMBIGUOUS / likely placeholder copy).

nodes.label: SIXN Website Homepage Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Full-page capture of the SIXN e-commerce storefront home page; dark theme with red accents, bold wide display typography for a streetwear/fashion brand feel.

nodes.label: Roman Numeral IX Motif
nodes.rationale: AMBIGUOUS: red serif 'IX' reads as Roman numeral nine embedded in 'SIX'; intended meaning (nine vs. stylized letters) is unclear.

nodes.label: SIXN Logo (Red Variant)
nodes.rationale: Wordmark on black background: heavy white geometric sans-serif 'S' and 'N' framing a red serif 'IX' in the middle; contrast of modern sans and classical serif highlights the IX.

nodes.label: Roman Numeral IX Motif
nodes.rationale: Red serif 'IX' is the visible part of the mark, possibly a wordplay on the 'ix' inside SIXN (AMBIGUOUS).

nodes.label: SIXN Logo (Transparent)
nodes.rationale: Wordmark on a transparent background. Only the middle 'IX' shows, in bold crimson serif capitals with a slight bevel. The wide empty margins suggest the 'S' and 'N' are white or light and invisible on a light background (AMBIGUOUS). That would make the full mark read S-IX-N, with 'IX' doubling as the Roman numeral nine. Transparent version meant for dark backgrounds on the web.

nodes.label: Topographic Contour Line Pattern
nodes.rationale: Organic S-curve lines evoke topographic map contours or flowing wave motif (AMBIGUOUS whether intended as map contours or abstract waves); adds texture without visual clutter.

nodes.label: background.png
nodes.rationale: Minimal decorative web background: thin dark-brown flowing contour-style lines on a white field, kept sparse so foreground content stays readable.

nodes.label: IX Roman Numeral Logo
nodes.rationale: Crimson serif 'IX' (Roman numeral nine) brand mark on white; classical serif with subtle gradient/bevel conveys heritage/premium tone. Meaning of IX in project context is AMBIGUOUS (possibly the number nine or a brand abbreviation).

nodes.label: IX Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: Small icon-sized brand mark: the letters 'IX' in a dark crimson serif typeface on a transparent/white background. Classical serif styling suggests a formal or traditional identity; likely used as a favicon or site logo in web media.
